about: CODATA 2014 recommended values of the fundamental physical constants, the complete NIST listing, parsed field by field. Source: NIST, physics.nist.gov/constants — ArchiveASCII/allascii_2014.txt, retrieved 2026-11-07. digits is the value exactly as NIST prints it (spaces removed); value is the same as a float; uncertainty is the standard uncertainty (0 for exact).
